d: Embers of the Uncrowned is a newly announced dark-fantasy MMORPG from Nexon that leans heavily into Diablo-style isometric combat, combining fast, skill-based action with brutal, gore-filled visuals. Set on a war-torn continent devastated by a massive elven invasion, the game puts you in the role of the last heir to a fallen noble house, fighting to reclaim your land and restore your legacy. (Gematsu) Combat is designed to be both fast and tactical, with multiple distinct classes like the Spectral Blade, Executioner, and Stormbringer, each offering unique abilities and playstyles. You’ll also recruit companions and team up with other players to take on massive bosses, raids, and large-scale PvE threats that require coordination and strategy. (Gematsu) Beyond combat, the game features settlement building and progression systems, letting you grow your domain from a small camp into a thriving city as you liberate regions and expand your influence. With deep customization, co-op gameplay, and a grim narrative, Embers of the Uncrowned aims to deliver a brutal, modern take on the MMORPG formula. (store.steampowered.com) #EmbersOfTheUncrowned #NEXON #EmbersGame #MMORPG #ActionRPG #DarkFantasy #IsometricGame #PCgaming #OnlineMultiplayer #RaidGame

The condition of the victims, aged 15 to 18, ranged from non-life-threatening to serious. Legend says it’s the soul of someone whose burial shroud was never released… trapped, wrapped, and restless. They’re said to hop, not walk — bound by the cloth — appearing pale, bruised, and silent. If you ever hear knocking at night or see one watching from a distance… run. 👻 This clip is going viral right now, and honestly, the movement in the background gave me chills. Real or staged? 🎬 Munkar – Fear Rooted in Faith and Consequences Munkar is an Indonesian horror film that blends supernatural elements with themes of faith, guilt, and moral consequences. Set in a strict religious boarding school, the story follows a troubled student whose behavior begins to raise concern among teachers and classmates. After a disturbing incident, the atmosphere in the school changes. Strange and unsettling events start to occur, creating fear and confusion among everyone. It soon becomes clear that something beyond normal understanding is at play—something connected to past actions and hidden truths. The film builds tension through its eerie setting and emotional depth rather than relying only on sudden scares. It explores how fear can grow from within, especially when secrets refuse to stay buried. Munkar is not just a horror story—it’s a haunting reflection on choices, belief, and the consequences that follow #fypシ #fyp #movie #tiktok

d: Penampskan Kuntilanak Diatas Pohon Nangka Kuntilanak adalah sosok hantu perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Indonesia, khususnya di Jawa, Sumatra, dan Kalimantan. Ia sering digambarkan berambut panjang, berpakaian putih, dan wajahnya pucat. Konon, kuntilanak adalah arwah wanita yang meninggal saat hamil atau melahirkan, dan belum tenang. Ciri khasnya adalah tawa melengking dan kehadirannya sering ditandai dengan bau bunga kamboja. Ia dipercaya suka muncul di malam hari, bertengger di pohon, terutama pohon pisang, dan bisa menyerupai wanita cantik untuk menyesatkan orang. Meski menyeramkan, kisah tentang kuntilanak juga sering dijadikan bagian dari budaya lisan untuk mengajarkan nilai moral atau sekadar hiburan dalam bentuk cerita horor.
zh: 菠萝蜜树上的孕妇鬼身影 孕妇鬼是印尼民间传说中，尤以爪哇、苏门答腊和加里曼丹地区的女鬼形象。她常被描绘为长发、白衣、脸色苍白。据说，孕妇鬼是怀孕或分娩时死亡、且未得安息的女性的灵魂。其特征是尖锐的笑声，出现时常伴有鸡蛋花的香味。她被认为喜欢在夜晚出现，栖于树上，尤其是香蕉树，并能化身美女迷惑人。尽管恐怖，但关于孕妇鬼的故事也常作为口述文化的一部分，用于传授道德价值观，或仅作为恐怖故事的娱乐。

d: #fyp #evil #haunted #entity #scary #demonic #face #possessed #scream Face Your Fears! - Horrifying Paranormal Capture that Defies Belief! Kayleigh and I were doing a Spirit Box session, with a K2 Meter being present. We do these almost every week, but rarely capture anything. The K2 Meter was flashing all the way to red! So we stuck at it to see if something would manifest. During the session, I went very cold (but also hot too?). My extremities were like ice, but my chest and face were burning hot. Then I suddenly got this insane headache! Like a migraine splitting my skull in two. It was completely debilitating. I also felt very sick too. I remember Kayleigh asking me if I was OK, and the next thing she was screaming! She was so very clearly scared and was a little angry too. I think it scared her quite badly. She was adamant that I shouted "GET OUT" and when I did, my face didn't look right either! I knew she wasn't joking as I could see it in her face! After watching the footage back, I am at a complete loss as to explain what happened! I have ZERO memory of this event happening and it seems so weird to me! I felt out of body in the moment, but normality slowly returned. @Girl Carnage @ThatGemKid @jamiecottee

zh: 直面你的恐惧！——令人难以置信的恐怖超自然捕捉！凯莉和我当时正在做灵魂盒对话，旁边放着K2电磁场检测仪。我们几乎每周都做，但很少捕捉到什么。当时K2仪表的灯一直闪到红色！所以我们坚持尝试，看是否会有东西显现。在对话过程中，我一下子变得很冷（但同时又很热？）。我的四肢像冰一样，但胸口和脸却滚烫。然后我突然感到一阵剧烈的头痛！就像偏头痛要把我的脑袋劈成两半。这让我完全无法招架。我也觉得非常恶心。我记得凯莉问我是否还好，接着她就尖叫起来！她显然非常害怕，还有点生气。我想那把她吓得不轻。她坚称我当时大喊了一声“滚出去”，而且我喊的时候，我的脸看起来也不对劲！我知道她不是在开玩笑，因为我能从她脸上看出来！回看录像后，我完全无法解释发生了什么！我对这件事毫无记忆，这对我来说太奇怪了！那一瞬间我感觉灵魂出窍，但后来慢慢恢复了正常。@Girl Carnage @ThatGemKid @jamiecottee

Facts 😂.                                           (2015) The viral "Guy Disappearing" meme featured internet personality Nileseyy Niles. • The meme originated from a comedy video titled "When you not tryna get jumped • ". • In the clip, Nileseyy suddenly appears to vanish mid-run using a simple editing effect, creating the illusion that he instantly escaped danger. • The low-budget visual effect and exaggerated situation became part of what made the video so funny online. • The meme spread heavily across Vine, Twitter, YouTube, and later TikTok as a reaction format for avoiding awkward or dangerous situations. • Fans often used the clip to joke about "disappearing" whenever problems, responsibilities, or drama appeared. • The video became one of the recognizable short-form internet memes from the mid-2010s era of viral comedy content.
zh: 事实如此 😂。(2015) 那个爆火的"消失的家伙"梗的主角是网络红人 Nileseyy Niles。该梗源自一个名为"当你不想被围殴时"的搞笑视频。在片段中，Nileseyy 通过简单的剪辑效果，在奔跑中突然凭空消失，制造出他瞬间逃离危险的错觉。低成本的视觉效果和夸张的情境正是该视频在网上如此搞笑的部分原因。该梗在 Vine、Twitter、YouTube 以及后来的 TikTok 上广泛传播，成为一种躲避尴尬或危险情境的反应格式。粉丝们常用这个片段来调侃"消失"，每当问题、责任或麻烦出现时。该视频成为 2010 年代中期病毒式搞笑内容时代最具辨识度的短视频网络梗之一。

d: POV: The baby is delivered… but still inside a clear, fluid-filled bubble. 👶✨ That’s not a complication. That’s a rare and beautiful moment. This is called an en caul birth 🌊 The newborn emerges completely enclosed within the intact amniotic sac — like a tiny water balloon cradling new life. What happens next? 👇 🩺 The medical team carefully opens the membrane 💧 Amniotic fluid drains 🫁 Air reaches the lungs 👶 First breath. First cry. It looks dramatic — but it’s a natural obstetric variation. High-yield facts 📚 • Extremely rare (more common in preterm births) • Usually seen in cesarean deliveries • The sac protects the baby during birth • Requires swift but gentle membrane rupture after delivery Exam pearl 💡 En caul ≠ complication. It’s simply delivery with intact membranes. zh: POV：宝宝娩出了……但仍被清澈、充满液体的囊泡完整包裹着。👶✨ 这不是并发症。这是一个罕见而美丽的瞬间。这叫做“胎膜完整分娩” 🌊 新生儿完全包裹在完整的羊膜囊中——就像一个承载着新生命的小水球。接下来会发生什么？ 👇 🩺 医疗团队小心地打开胎膜 💧 羊水流出 🫁 空气进入肺部 👶 第一次呼吸。第一声啼哭。看起来戏剧化——但这是一种自然的产科变异。高产出知识点 📚 • 极其罕见（早产中更常见） • 常见于剖宫产 • 囊膜在分娩过程中保护婴儿 • 分娩后需迅速但轻柔地破膜 考试锦囊 💡 胎膜完整分娩 ≠ 并发症。这只是完整胎膜内的分娩。对许多临床医生来说，这是职业生涯中仅有一次的超现实时刻。 ✨ 如果你喜欢罕见的产科瞬间，就保存吧 💛 艾特一个对分娩科学着迷的人 👶

d: You’ve Never Seen Dance Moves Like This The Dero dance is a high-energy routine known for its wild, unpredictable movements and nonstop flow. At first glance it looks chaotic, but a closer look reveals rhythm, timing, and impressive control. Dancers groove with their whole body, following the beat in a way that feels both messy and skillful. In some communities, this style has been practiced for decades, keeping the tradition alive through festivals, gatherings, and friendly competitions. It’s a unique combination of fun, endurance, and cultural identity that continues to stand out today.  #derodance #indonesia #tradition #interesting #interestingfacts #knowledge

d: Video latihan tari di Sanggar Pradnya Swari, Jembrana, Bali, viral di media sosial. Anak-anak yang berlatih—baik laki-laki maupun perempuan—tampak serius menguasai nyeledet, gerak mata khas dalam tari Bali. Nyeledet bukan sekadar melirik, tetapi gerakan cepat dan tajam yang harus selaras dengan ekspresi wajah, posisi kepala, dan irama gamelan. Teknik ini dikenal sulit karena membutuhkan konsentrasi tinggi serta kontrol otot mata yang kuat. Merujuk kajian seniman dan akademisi tari Bali, I Wayan Dibia, nyeledet menjadi elemen penting dalam membangun karakter tarian seperti Legong dan Kebyar, sekaligus menunjukkan kedalaman ekspresi penari. Dalam video yang beredar, anak-anak tampak berulang kali mengulang gerakan demi mencapai ketepatan. Latihan intens itu menggambarkan proses panjang di balik keindahan tari Bali yang selama ini terlihat memukau di atas panggung. #BALI #videoviral #tari
zh: 巴厘岛Jembrana的Pradnya Swari舞团练习视频在社交媒体走红。认真练习的孩子们——无论男女——都在努力掌握nyeledet（巴厘舞蹈中标志性的眼神动作）。Nyeledet不仅是瞥视，而是需与面部表情、头部位置和甘美兰节奏同步的快速、锐利动作。此技巧以难著称，因需高度专注和极强的眼部肌肉控制。据巴厘舞蹈艺术家、学者I Wayan Dibia的研究，nyeledet是塑造Legong和Kebyar等舞蹈角色、展现舞者表现深度的关键元素。在流传的视频中，孩子们为达精准反复练习，高强度训练展现了巴厘舞蹈惊艳舞台背后漫长的过程。

d: In standard Thai, ร (ร เรือ) is pronounced with an /r/ sound. This is what you’ll learn in school and what’s considered the standard pronunciation   But in everyday spoken Thai, you’ll often hear something different. Depending on the speaker, region, and how casually they’re speaking, ร เรือ (r) may sound closer to ล ลิง (L), or sometimes the sound is dropped altogether. For example: โรงเรียน (school) Standard: roong-riian  Casual speech: you might hear something closer to loong-liian  Does that mean learning the R sound is unnecessary? Not at all If you’re learning Thai, it’s useful to understand both the standard pronunciation and the way Thai people actually speak. That way, you can pronounce words correctly and understand native speakers when their pronunciation changes in everyday conversation 🇹🇭 #learnthai #speakthai #thaiwithfah #learnthailanguage #thailanguage
zh: 在标准泰语中，ร (ร เรือ) 发 /r/ 音。这是你在学校学到的，也是标准发音。但在日常口语中，你经常会听到不同的发音。根据说话者、地区和随意程度，ร เรือ (r) 的发音可能更接近 ล ลิง (L)，有时甚至完全不发音。例如：โรงเรียน (学校) 标准发音：roong-riian 口语发音：你可能会听到类似 loong-liian 的音。这是否意味着学习 R 音没有必要？完全不是。如果你在学习泰语，了解标准发音和泰国人的实际说话方式都很有用。这样，你就能正确发音，并在日常对话中理解母语者发音变化时的意思。

zh: 辣巴东牛肉🥩🍛 每次参加完17周年庆比赛回来，我都特别饿。关键就是得吃印尼菜，味道要辣、要香、要好吃、要浓郁😍🥰 🔽食谱🔽 炖煮材料： 1公斤牛肉 10颗红葱头，磨碎 10瓣大蒜，磨碎 1汤匙罗望子酱 3片月桂叶 4根香茅 1拇指大小生姜 8片青柠叶 1汤匙香菜粉 1/2汤匙盐 1汤匙味精 1汤匙牛肉味鸡粉 1.1升嫩椰子水 研磨香料： 12个红甜椒 20个红辣椒 5个红小米椒 18颗红葱头 4瓣大蒜 炒香料： Sunco 食用油 研磨香料 8片青柠叶 1茶匙牛肉味鸡粉 1茶匙味精 ½茶匙盐 1汤匙罗望子汁 你们17周年庆都干嘛了？我嘛，还是在家做印尼菜，用的油当然是 SunCo，好味道是粘在食物上，不是油浮在表面。而且 SunCo 是百分百印尼原产食用油🥰😍

Garlic parmesan cheeseburger bombs 🍔  For all of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store! Save this recipe and thank me later 😌 RECIPE ⬇️ * 1 lb 80/20 ground beef * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  * 2 tsp Worcestershire  * Minced garlic  * Salt & pepper to taste  * Optional add-ins: caramelized onions, bacon * Mild cheddar, large cubes * Shredded mozzarella  * 1 can biscuit dough (Pillsbury original flakey layers, red top) * 1 egg, whisked (for egg wash) * Parmesan  Garlic butter: * 3 tbs salted butter, melted * 2 cloves garlic, finely minced * Dried or fresh parsley 1. Cook the ground beef on medium heat. Once browned, add minced garlic and all the seasonings. Stir for a minute. Set aside.  2. Preheat oven to 375F 3. Take each biscuit and stretch it into a 5 inch circle. Add 2 spoonfuls of seasoned beef, some mozzarella, and a cube of cheese in the middle.  4. Fold the dough around the filling and pinch the edges tightly to seal. Pull it into a tight ball. Rest 5 min. 5. Place them seam side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush a thin layer of egg wash and sprinkle fresh grated parmesan. 6. Bake at 375F for 15-18 min until deeply golden. 7. Brush on garlic butter and sprinkle more parmesan. Serve immediately. #cheeseburgers #garlicparmesan #garlicknots #dinneridea #cheapmeals

d: Resep Ayam Goreng Padang (untuk 8 porsi) Bahan marinasi: 2 ekor ayam pejantan utuh 1 buah jeruk nipis bumbu halus Bahan bumbu halus: 6 siung bawang putih 2 sdt ketumbar 4 cm jahe, iris 4 cm kunyit, iris 8 cm lengkuas, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk, buang batang 2 sdt garam 2 sdt kaldu ayam bubuk ¼ sdt merica 1 sdt penyedap 75 gr kelapa parut 4 sdm tepung beras 2 butir telur Bahan sambal cabe ijo: 100 ml minyak 15 siung bawang merah 160 gr cabai hijau, potong 2 buah tomat hijau, iris 5 lembar daun jeruk 1 sdt garam 1 sdt penyedap Pelengkap: nasi putih timun, kupas jeruk nipis Cara membuat: 1. Untuk bumbu halus, siapkan blender dan masukkan bawang putih, ketumbar, jahe, kunyit, lengkuas, daun jeruk, garam, kaldu ayam bubuk, merica, penyedap, kelapa parut, tepung beras dan telur, lalu haluskan 2. Potong ayam menjadi empat bagian dan buang kulitnya. Marinasi ayam dengan perasan jeruk nipis dan bumbu halus, aduk merata. Diamkan minimal 1 jam di suhu ruang atau semalaman di kulkas 3. Goreng ayam yang sudah dimarinasi di minyak panas dengan api sedang hingga matang kecokelatan, angkat dan tiriskan 4. Untuk tambahan serundeng, goreng sisa bumbu marinasi hingga kuning keemasan lalu angkat dan tiriskan 5. Untuk sambal cabe ijo, panaskan minyak sisa menggoreng ayam, lalu masukkan bawang merah dan cabai hijau yang sudah dipotong, tumis hingga layu. Siapkan food chopper dan masukkan tumisan bawang merah dan cabai hijau, lalu haluskan sesaat 6. Tumis tomat hijau dengan minyak sisa tumisan bawang dan cabai. Tambahkan daun jeruk dan bahan sambal yang sudah dihaluskan, tumis sesaat. Tambahkan garam dan penyedap, aduk rata 7. Ayam Goreng Padang siap disajikan
zh: 巴东风味炸鸡食谱（8人份） 腌料： 2只整鸡 1个青柠 香料酱 香料酱材料： 6瓣大蒜 2茶匙芫荽籽 4厘米生姜，切片 4厘米姜黄，切片 8厘米高良姜，切片 5片青柠叶，去梗 2茶匙盐 2茶匙鸡精粉 1/4茶匙白胡椒粉 1茶匙味精 75克椰丝 4汤匙粘米粉 2个鸡蛋 青辣椒酱材料： 100毫升油 15颗红葱头 160克青辣椒，切段 2个青番茄，切片 5片青柠叶 1茶匙盐 1茶匙味精 配菜： 白米饭 黄瓜，去皮 青柠 做法： 1. 制作香料酱：将大蒜、芫荽籽、生姜、姜黄、高良姜、青柠叶、盐、鸡精粉、白胡椒粉、味精、椰丝、粘米粉和鸡蛋放入搅拌机，打碎成糊。 2. 将鸡切成四大块，去掉鸡皮。用青柠汁和香料酱腌制鸡肉，拌匀。室温下至少腌1小时，或冰箱冷藏过夜。 3. 将腌好的鸡肉放入热油中，中火炸至熟透呈棕褐色，捞出沥油。 4. 制作椰丝脆：将剩余的腌料炸至金黄，捞出沥油。 5. 制作青辣椒酱：加热炸鸡剩下的油，放入红葱头和切好的青辣椒，炒至软蔫。将炒好的红葱头和青辣椒放入食物料理机，粗略打碎。 6. 用剩余底油炒青番茄，加入青柠叶和打碎的辣椒酱，快速翻炒。加入盐和味精，拌匀。 7. 巴东风味炸鸡即可上桌

d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.
zh: 印尼炒饭 食材 3瓣大蒜，切碎 1个鸡蛋 3杯熟米饭 4片鱼饼，切薄片 4只大虾，去壳去虾线 一把新鲜鱿鱼，处理干净后切片 1汤匙生抽 2汤匙甜酱油 1茶匙黑酱油 1汤匙参巴酱（用量可调整） 一大撮味精 1根小米椒，切碎 1根小葱，切葱花 2汤匙炸蒜 黄瓜片和番茄片，配餐用 煎蛋，配餐用 步骤 1. 大火烧热炒锅，加入少许油。放入蒜末炒香。 2. 打入鸡蛋，快速炒散，使其成小块状。 3. 加入熟米饭，充分翻炒，打散结块，确保米饭均匀裹上蛋液和蒜香。 4. 加入鱼饼、虾和鱿鱼，一起翻炒至海鲜熟透。 5. 加入生抽、甜酱油、黑酱油和参巴酱，翻炒均匀，使酱汁完全包裹米饭和配料。 6. 放入小米椒和葱花，快速翻炒几下。 7. 撒上炸蒜，最后翻炒一次。 8. 趁热上桌，配上黄瓜片和番茄片，顶部放一个煎蛋。

Mom’s Indonesian Beef Rendang 🇲🇨   What I grew up eating for over 17 years back in my hometown, Indonesia🇲🇨😍. Today, I share this recipe with you, in honor of Indonesia's Independence Day. Happy Independence Day Indonesia, Indonesia MERDEKA! 🇮🇩✨ Ingredients A: 1.4kg of beef, topside or silverside, diced into 4cm chunks 800ml of regular coconut cream 400ml of coconut milk 1 tbsp of chicken powder 1 tbsp of Sugar 2 tsp of salt 2 tbsp of coconut sugar 6 tbsp of vegetable oil for stir fry  Ingredients B, to blend: 15 cloves of garlic  3 medium onions or 250g, chopped 30g of ginger,, cut into small pieces  30g of turmeric, cut into small pieces 6 candlenuts 30g of galangal, cut into small pieces 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped 6 tbsp of vegetable oil, to blend Ingredients C: 5 bay leaves 8 kaffir lime leaves 4 lemongrass, chopped 8 cloves wholes 3 cinnamon sticks 4 cardamoms 4 star anises Seasoning: 2 tsp of cilantro ground 2 tsp of turmeric ground 2 tsp of white pepper 2 tsp of cinnamon powder Steps: 1. Cut the beef into 4cm chunks and do not cut the beef into smaller pieces as they will break down during the cooking. 2. Add all of the Ingredients B in a blender or food processor. Then, blend it or give it a blitz until all the become a thick paste. Set aside 3. In the heavily-bottomed pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. 4. Then, pour the paste (from Ingredients B) into the pan and cook the paste until fragrant for 2 minutes. 5. Add the “Ingredients C” to the pan and stir to mix. 6. Next, add the “Seasoning” and followed by chicken powder, sugar and salt to the pan. Cook the paste until fragrant ( the paste will change color to red-brown ish ) 7. Add the beef to the pan and cook the beef until it is lightly browned.  8. Add coconut milk into the pan and stir to combine. Then, add coconut cream and bring it to simmer. 9. Cover and simmer in low heat for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens. (Stir it periodically to prevent the meat from burning) 10. Once the sauce has thickened and released reddish oil, add coconut sugar and give it a final mix. 11. Cover and simmer for another 30 minutes until it turns into dark brown. 12. Once it is done, enjoy with a bowl of rice! Notes: You should let the meat sit overnight for the flavors to be fully absorbed in the meat #indonesianfood #beefrendang #dinnerideas #easyrecipes

Ayam Penyet is an Indonesian dish made of fried chicken that’s been gently smashed to make it extra tender. The chicken is usually marinated with garlic, turmeric, and spices, then deep-fried until crispy.  Recipe I used: 4 chicken legs or thighs (bone-in for best flavour) 4 cloves garlic 4 shallots 3 candlenuts (or substitute 6–8 cashews) 2 cm galangal 1 tsp ground coriander ½ tsp turmeric powder 1 tsp salt 1 tsp sugar 120 ml water (½ cup) - Blend the garlic, shallots, candlenuts, galangal, coriander, turmeric, salt, sugar, and water into a smooth paste. - ⁠Pour the paste into a wok with 2 tbsp of oil, place chicken into the paste, then fry on medium high heat for 5 minutes. Flipping every minute. Now add in enough water to cover the chicken and simmer for 35-40 minutes, flipping halfway. - ⁠remove the cooked chicken and strain the liquid - ⁠boil it till the volume reduces by half then season to taste with salt Batter: 150 ml of the leftover chicken cooking liquid 80 g rice flour 20 g corn flour ½ tsp baking powder - whisk all the ingredients together, then dip the chicken into this wet batter, coating it well - ⁠deep fry at 180°C or 360°F till golden brown, remember that the chicken is already cooked so you're just crisping up the crust - ⁠serve with rice and sambal/chilli paste Sambal recipe: 6–8 red chilies 5 bird’s eye chilies 3 garlic 3 shallots 1 tomato 1 tsp toasted belacan/shrimp paste 1 tsp sugar Salt + lime juice - dry fry all the ingredients except the sugar salt and lime  - ⁠pound the ingredients together into a rough paste then season with sugar salt and lime juice #ayampenyet #indonesianfood #friedchicken #chickenrecipe #friedchickenrecipe

KUE TETE / APE (aka Boobie Cake) 😜✨ Welcome to my “Learning How to Cook Indonesian Food” series!  Where I challenge myself to learn a new Indonesian Recipe every week. This week is all about KUE APE - one of Indonesia’s most nostalgic sweet streetfood treats. 🇮🇩🙌🏼 We often call it Kue Tete (Titty Cake) cause…. I mean… is it not obvious?? 🤣 It’s thin and crispy on the edges, with a centre that’s thicker, soft, fluffy, and slightly chewy. It tastes like pandan and coconut and it’s absolutely DELISH! 💕 INGREDIENTS - 170g All Purpose Flour (Medium Protein) 45gr Rice Flour 35gr Tapioca Flour 1/4tsp Salt 145gr Sugar 1tsp Baking Powder 1/4tsp Baking Soda 1tsp Panda Paste or Extract 150gr Instant Coconut Cream 350gr Water HOW TO COOK - 1. Add All Purpose Flour, Rice Flour, Tapioca Flour, Salt, Sugar, Baking Powder and Baking Soda in a bowl. Give it a whisk.  2. Then add the Pandan Extract, Instant Coconut Cream, and Water to the bowl. Whisk thoroughly, and rest the batter for 30min.  3. Heat up a small non-stick wok. Once hot, add a ladle of batter, and turn the wok all around (so the batter gets to the sides of the wok and makes a circle shape). Close the wok with a lid, and cook the kue ape over low-medium heat until the sides turn light brown. 4. Take the Kue Ape off the wok, let it cool slightly and eat! Recook from @Luvita Ho ✨ #indonesianfood #kueape #easyrecipe #themainingredient #MakanDenganMakna

d: Pernah nggak sih, pengen masakan rumahan yang sederhana tapi rasanya “wah”? 💯 Hari ini aku masak Ayam Acar Kuning… dan jujur, ini tipe lauk yang bikin nasi di rumah cepat habis. 🔥🍀 Rasanya? Gurih, sedikit asam, ada pedasnya juga. Balance banget. Ini bukan cuma masakan… tapi comfort food yang selalu bikin kangen rumah. 🏡 RESEP AYAM ACAR KUNING - By Rudy Choirudin 🍀 Bahan 1: • 500 Gr Ayam • 1/2 Saset Bumbu Desaku Marinasi • 1 Saset Desaku bawang putih bubuk • 1/2 SDT Ladaku merica bubuk • 2 SDM Tepung Maizena • 2 SDM Air Bahan 2: (blender/haluskan) • 8 buah Bawang Merah • 3 butir Kemiri Goreng • 3 Cm Jahe • 1 SDT Desaku kunyit bubuk • 1/2 SDT Ladaku merica bubuk • 1 SDT Garam • 3 SDM Air Bahan 3: • 4 SDM Minyak Goreng (untuk menumis) • 1 batang Serai • 2 lembar Daun Salam • 150 ml Air • 1 SDM Gula • 1 saset Desaku bawang putih bubuk Bahan 4: • 8 buah Cabe Rawit • 50 Gr Wortel (potong batang korek lebih tebal) • 50 Gr Timun (potong batang korek lebih tebal) • 1 SDT Cuka Cara Memasak: 1. Campur semua Bahan 1 ke dalam kontainer, kocok rata kemudian diamkan 30 menit. 2. Goreng Ayam sampai kuning keemasan, tiriskan. 3. Blender Bahan 2, sampai halus. 4. Panaskan Minyak, masukkan bumbu yang sudah dihaluskan (Bahan 2). Tumis sampai harum dan matang. 5. Tambahkan Serai dan Daun Salam, tumis sampai mengeluarkan aroma. 6. Masukkan 150 ml Air, aduk merata hingga kuah mulai mengental. 7. Tambahkan Gula dan Desaku bawang putih bubuk, aduk rata. 8. Masukkan cabe rawit dan wortel, tambahkan timun dan cuka, aduk sesaat. 9. zh: 有没有过这种感觉，想吃简单但味道惊艳的家常菜？今天我做了黄姜醋鸡，说实话，这菜能让家里的米饭迅速见底。味道咸鲜、微酸、带点辣，非常均衡。这不只是一道菜，更是让人想家的疗愈食物。黄姜醋鸡食谱 - 作者 Rudy Choirudin 食材1：500克鸡肉、半包Desaku腌料、1包Desaku大蒜粉、半茶匙Ladaku胡椒粉、2汤匙玉米淀粉、2汤匙水 食材2（搅打细腻）：8个红葱头、3颗烤石栗、3厘米生姜、1茶匙Desaku姜黄粉、半茶匙Ladaku胡椒粉、1茶匙盐、3汤匙水 食材3：4汤匙食用油（用于炒制）、1根香茅、2片月桂叶、150毫升水、1汤匙糖、1包Desaku大蒜粉 食材4：8个小米辣、50克胡萝卜（切粗条）、50克黄瓜（切粗条）、1茶匙醋 烹饪步骤：1. 将食材1混合，摇匀腌制30分钟。2. 将鸡肉炸至金黄，沥干。3. 将食材2搅打细腻。4. 烧热油，放入搅打好的食材2，炒香炒熟。5. 加入香茅和月桂叶，炒出香味。6. 加入150毫升水，搅拌至汤汁变浓稠。7. 加入糖和Desaku大蒜粉，拌匀。8. 加入小米辣和胡萝卜，再加入黄瓜和醋，快速翻炒。9. 放入炸鸡，煮至入味。10. 出锅装盘。完整视频食谱见我的YouTube和Facebook：@ResepSatset_Rudy 和 @BukuResepSatsetRudy

Blender Bahan 2, sampai halus. 2. Panaskan 5 SDM Minyak Goreng, tumis bumbu yang sudah diblender (Bahan 2) sampai naik minyak. 3. Tambahkan Serai, Daun Salam dan Daun Jeruk, tumis sampai mengeluarkan aroma. 4. Masukkan Ayam, tumis Ayam sampai berubah warna. 5. Masukkan kentang dan wortel. Tambahkan Air, Garam dan Gula (Bahan 4), masak selama 10 menit, dengan wajan tertutup. 6. Tambahkan Santan kental Instan dan Air (Bahan 5). Masak lagi 10 menit 7. Angkat dan sajikan. d: Resep Panada Tongkol Rica (untuk 12 pcs) Bahan adonan panada: 100 ml air hangat 6 gr ragi 15 gr gula pasir 300 gr tepung terigu protein sedang ½ sdt garam 1 butir telur 30 gr santan 25 gr margarin, lelehkan Bahan isian: 200 gr ikan tongkol kukus, suwir 1 sdt garam 1 ½ sdm gula pasir 1 sdt penyedap 80 ml minyak, untuk menumis Bahan bumbu halus tongkol rica: 10 siung bawang merah 4 siung bawang putih 4 cm jahe, potong 3 cm kunyit, potong 12 buah cabai rawit merah 2 buah cabai merah besar 60 ml air Bahan aromatik: 1 batang serai, geprek 2 lembar daun salam 1 lembar daun pandan 3 lembar daun jeruk Cara membuat: 1. Untuk adonan, buat larutan ragi dengan mencampurkan ragi dan gula pasir ke dalam air hangat, aduk kemudian diamkan sesaat 2. Siapkan mangkuk, tuangkan tepung terigu dan garam lalu aduk rata. Buat rongga di tengah mangkuk, kemudian tuangkan larutan ragi, telur, santan, dan margarin yang sudah dilelehkan, aduk hingga rata 3. Uleni adonan hingga permukaannya halus dan tidak lengket, bulatkan dan tutup dengan plastic wrap, istirahatkan selama 30 menit atau hingga mengembang 4. Untuk isian, siapkan blender lalu masukkan bawang merah, bawang putih, jahe, kunyit, cabai rawit merah, cabai merah besar, dan air, lalu haluskan 5. Panaskan minyak, masukkan bumbu halus bersama serai yang sudah digeprek, daun salam, daun pandan, dan daun jeruk. Tumis dengan api sedang-kecil hingga wangi 6. Masukkan tongkol suwir, garam, gula pasir, dan penyedap lalu aduk rata. Masak dengan api kecil hingga kering kemudian matikan api dan biarkan dingin 7. Buang gas pada adonan panada yang sudah mengembang, bagi adonan menjadi 12 bagian masing-masing berat 40-42 gr. Bulatkan adonan dan istirahatkan kembali selama 5-10 menit 8. Pipihkan adonan kemudian beri isian tongkol rica sekitar 20 gr. Lipat dan tutup adonan kemudian ulir bagian pinggir adonan hingga benar-benar rapat. Diamkan panada yang sudah dibentuk selama 10-15 menit sebelum digoreng 9. Goreng panada di minyak panas dengan api sedang-kecil selama 1 ½ menit di masing-masing sisi atau hingga matang kecokelatan 10. Panada siap disajikan

d: Resepi Ikan Tenggiri Masak Asam Jangan lupa save. Bahan-bahan * 1 ekor ikan tenggiri (dipotong) * Serbuk kunyit secukupnya * Garam secukupnya * Minyak untuk menggoreng Bahan tumis * 5 biji bawang merah kecil (dibiarkan sebiji) * 3 ulas bawang putih (dihiris) * 1 tangkai cili besar hijau (dipotong kasar) * 2 tangkai cili padi merah (dipotong kasar) Bahan kuah * 1 cawan air asam jawa * Air secukupnya untuk kuah * 2 biji tomato (dipotong) * Sos tiram secukupnya * Garam secukup rasa * Serbuk perasa secukup rasa * Sedikit gula Cara Memasak 1. Gaulkan ikan tenggiri bersama serbuk kunyit dan garam, kemudian goreng hingga garing. Angkat dan ketepikan. 2. Panaskan sedikit minyak, kemudian tumis bahan tumis hingga naik bau dan sedikit layu. 3. Masukkan air secukupnya bersama 1 cawan air asam jawa. Biarkan kuah mendidih. 4. Masukkan sos tiram, garam, serbuk perasa dan sedikit gula. Kacau hingga sebati dan sesuaikan rasa. 5. Masukkan ikan tenggiri yang telah digoreng, kemudian biarkan kuah mereneh seketika supaya rasa lebih meresap. 6. Masukkan tomato dan masak sekejap hingga tomato sedikit lembut. 7. Tutup api dan sedia untuk dihidangkan bersama nasi panas. Tip: Jangan gaul terlalu kuat selepas masukkan ikan supaya isi tak mudah hancur. Kalau suka kuah lebih pekat, biarkan mereneh sekejap sebelum tutup api. Selamat Mencuba 😋 #resepi #ikantenggiri #masakdirumah
zh: 马来酸辣鲅鱼食谱，记得收藏。材料：1条鲅鱼（切块）、适量姜黄粉、适量盐、煎炸用油。爆香料：5粒小洋葱（整粒）、3瓣大蒜（切片）、1根大青椒（切粗块）、2根红小米椒（切粗块）。酱汁料：1杯酸角水、适量水、2个番茄（切块）、适量蚝油、适量盐、适量味精、少许糖。做法：1. 将鲅鱼块与姜黄粉和盐拌匀，然后炸至酥脆，捞出备用。2. 热少许油，爆香爆香料至出味并稍软。3. 加入适量水和1杯酸角水，煮沸。4. 加入蚝油、盐、味精和少许糖，搅拌均匀并调味。5. 放入炸好的鲅鱼，让酱汁慢炖片刻以便入味。6. 加入番茄，煮至番茄稍软。7. 关火，配热米饭享用。小贴士：放入鱼后不要大力搅拌，以免鱼肉易碎。如果喜欢浓稠酱汁，关火前可多炖一会儿。祝您尝试愉快。

d: One of Thailand’s most famous dishes and I Couldn’t stop eating this when I was over there so I had to recreate it at home to  best ofmy abilities. Spicy, fragrant and absolutely delicious. 📝INGREDIENTS  -jasmine rice  -pork/beef/ chicken mince and for one serving I used around 250-300g  -Thai holy basil *I got mine from a international food shop. Shoutout @mattas1984 ( if you can’t source it Thai basil is a good alternative but remember it’s not the same , I’ve also seen people use 80% Italian basil and 20% mint with a pinch of clove) For the sauce I liked mine a bit darker so you don’t have to use these exact measurements, once you use the fish, oyster and soy sauce you’re on the right track. I’ve even some places use chicken stock and they have the meat more soft than crispy , it’s really down to you. -2tsp fish sauce  -optionally a tsp of light soy  -1tsp dark soy -2tsp of oyster sauce  -6 garlic  -7-9 Thai red chillies if you want it spicy , 3-4 if you want it mild. If you can’t get Thai red chillies , normal red chillies can be used. -cooking oil  -shallots  -fried egg  -green beans  As always in my videos I just get ingredients that aren’t pricey and I always get them from Aldi/Lidil/Asda , Asian markets near me or Amazon. Follow for more naasty recipes if you enjoy or watch the longer more in depth versions of my videos on my YouTube channel 👍✅ #padkrapao #thaïfood #thaicooking #holybasil #staynaasty
zh: 泰国最著名的菜之一，在那边时根本停不下来，所以必须在家尽力复刻。辣、香、绝对美味。食材：茉莉香米、猪肉/牛肉/鸡肉碎（一人份约250-300克）、泰国圣罗勒（购自国际食品店，如果没有，泰国罗勒是不错的替代，但味道不同。也见过用80%意大利罗勒加20%薄荷和一点丁香的）。酱汁我偏好略深色，无需精确用量，加了鱼露、蚝油和酱油就对了。甚至有人加鸡汤让肉更软而非酥脆，全看个人喜好。2茶匙鱼露、可选1茶匙生抽、1茶匙老抽、2茶匙蚝油、6瓣大蒜、7-9个泰式红辣椒（喜辣）或3-4个（微辣），没有泰式红辣椒可用普通红辣椒。食用油、红葱头、煎蛋、四季豆。一如既往，我只用平价食材，购自Aldi/Lidl/Asda、附近亚洲超市或亚马逊。喜欢就关注获取更多美味食谱，或去我YouTube频道观看更详尽的视频版本。

d: #แจกสูตรหมกเห็ดเข็มทอง ใส่สมุนไพรเน้นๆ เพิ่มความนุ่มละมุนด้วยไข่ไก่ และความอร่อยจากหมูสับ บอกเลยว่าแซ่บมาก!! **อัตราส่วน** เห็ดเข็มทอง 500 กรัม ตะไคร้ซอย 3 ต้น กระเทียมจีน 5 กลีบ หอมแดง 6 หัว พริกแดงจินดา 20 เม็ด พริกแกงเผ็ด 1 ชต. หมูสับ 150 กรัม ไข่ไก่ 3 ฟอง น้ำปลา 1 ชต. น้ำตาลทราย 1 ชช. น้ำปลาร้า 2 ชต. (ใช้น้ำปลาร้าปรุงสำเร็จ) ผงชูรส 1 ชช.  ใบมะกรูดซอย 1-2 ชต. ใบแมงลัก 1 มัด ใบตอง,ไม้กลัด  วิธีทำ 1. นำเห็ดเข็มทองมาตัดโคนทิ้ง แล้วชั่งให้ได้ 500 กรัม นำไปล้างผ่านน้ำแบบเร็วๆ พักให้สะเด็ดน้ำ 2. โขลกเครื่องแกงได้แก่ ตะไคร้ซอย กระเทียมจีน หอมแดง และพริกแดงจินดา โขลกแค่พอหยาบๆ  3. นำเครื่องแกงที่โขลกแล้ว ใส่ลงไปในในชามผสม ตามด้วยพริกแกงเผ็ด ไข่ไก่ หมูสับ น้ำปลา น้ำตาลทราย น้ำปลาร้า และผงชูรส นวดคลุกเคล้าให้เข้ากันดี แล้วใส่เห็ดเข็มทองลงไป นวดจนทุกอย่างเข้ากันดี แล้วค่อยใส่ใบแมงลัก และใบมะกรูดซอย คลุกเคล้าให้เข้ากันดี 4. นำใบตองสองใบประกบกัน ตักส่วนผสมที่ได้ลงไปประมาณ 2 ชต.พูนๆ แล้วจัดการห่อเหมือนขนมใส่ไส้ นำไปนึ่งด้วยไฟกลางค่อนแรง 15-20 นาที 5. สูตรนี้ทำได้ประมาณ 10 ห่อ  **คำแนะนำ** เมื่อผสมทุกอย่างเข้ากันดีแล้ว ก่อนที่จะห่อใบตองแล้วนำไปนึ่ง เราสามารถชิมรสได้ โดยตักส่วนผสมสักเล็กน้อยใส่ถ้วยทนความร้อน นำเข้าไมโครเวฟให้สุกแล้วชิมรส ถ้าจืดไปก็สามารถเพิ่มน้ำปลา หรือน้ำปลาร้าได้  #หม#หมกเห็ดเข็มทองม#แม่ซีน้องมดดี้channel

d: แหนมสามชั้น  เปรี้ยว นัวกำลังดี ทอดกรอบๆ ทานกับน้ำพริก คือดีย์มากกก  วิธีทอดแหนมไม่ติดกระทะ คือใส่แป้งไปพร้อมน้ำมันเลยค่า กรอบ อร่อยสุดๆ ส่วนผสมและเครื่องปรุง  - หมูสามชั้นหั่นชิ้นกว้าง 2000 กรัม - ข้าวเหนียวนึ่งสุก 200 กรัม - กระเทียมสับหยาบ 200 กรัม - เกลือสมุทรป่น 3  ช้อนโต๊ะ  - พริกไทยป่น 1 ช้อนโต๊ะ  - ผงชูรส 2 ช้อนโต๊ะ - แป้งทอดกรอบ 3 ช้อนโต๊ะ  - น้ำมันสำหรับทอด 1/2 ลิตร *วางไว้อุณหภูมิห้อง 1 วัน ก็ทานได้แล้วค่ะ ใครชอบเปรี้ยวหน่อยก็ 2-3 วัน พอได้ความเปรี้ยวตามต้องการก็เก็บเข้าตู้เย็นได้เลยค่า  #แจกสูตร #แหนมทอด #สามชั้นทอด #ทำอาหาร

d: Sweet & Spicy Chicken Noodles 🍯🌶️🍜 These saucy noodles are ready in under 10 mins 🥣 Ingredients: -1 package hand cut noodles (dry) -Chili oil, to taste  -1 tbsp rice vinegar -2 tbsp soy sauce -1 clove garlic, minced -2 tbsp honey  -1 cup cooked chicken, chopped -2 Green onions, thinly sliced (divided)  -Sesame seeds, for serving Instructions: 1. Cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add the chili oil, rice vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, and honey to a pan over medium-low heat. Stir until combined and warmed through. 3. Add a splash of water to loosen the sauce if it gets too thick. 4. Toss in the chicken, cooked noodles and half of the green onions. Mix until fully coated. 5. Top with the remaining green onions and sesame seeds before serving. Enjoy!

d: วิธีทำ มินิซอฟคุกกี้ช็อกโกแลตชิป 🍪(Mini chocolate chip cookies)  #cookies #bakery #แจกสูตรเบเกอรี่ #แจกสูตรขนม #เมนูอร่อย 🍪 ส่วนผสม (ขนาด 8 กรัม ได้ 70-80 ชิ้น)  แป้งเอนกประสงค์ : 180 กรัม  เบกกิ้งโซดา: 1/2 ช้อนชา   เกลือป่น: 1/4 ช้อนชา  เนยจืด (อุณหภูมิห้อง): 115 กรัม  น้ำตาลทรายแดง: 90 กรัม  น้ำตาลทรายขาว: 60 กรัม  ไข่ไก่ : 1 ฟอง  กลิ่นวานิลลา: 1 ช้อนชา  ช็อกโกแลตชิป: 120 - 150 กรัม วอร์มเตาอบไว้ที่อุณหภูมิ 175 องศาเซลเซียส (ไฟบน-ล่าง ไม่เปิดพัดลม) วางก้อนคุกกี้ที่แช่เย็นแล้วลงบนถาดอบที่รองด้วยกระดาษไข อบเพียง 8 – 10 นาทีเท่านั้น เช็คความสุก: สังเกตว่าขอบคุกกี้เริ่มเปลี่ยนเป็นสีเหลืองทอง แต่ตรงกลางยังดูนุ่มและนิ่มอยู่ ถือว่าใช้ได้เลย นำออกจากเตาอบ พักไว้ในถาด 5 นาที ให้เซ็ตตัวก่อน (ตอนร้อนๆ จะนิ่มมากถ้าย้ายทันทีจะแตก) จากนั้นค่อยย้ายมาพักบนตะแกรงจนเย็นสนิท คุกกี้จะเซ็ตตัวจนขอบกรอบและตรงกลางหนึบพอดี

zh: 迷你巧克力软曲奇做法。配料（8克一个，约70-80个）：中筋面粉180克，小苏打1/2茶匙，细盐1/4茶匙，无盐黄油（室温）115克，红糖90克，白砂糖60克，鸡蛋1个，香草精1茶匙，巧克力豆120-150克。烤箱预热至175摄氏度（上下火，不开风扇）。将冷藏好的曲奇面团放到铺了烘焙纸的烤盘上。只烤8-10分钟。检查熟度：看到曲奇边缘开始变成金黄色，但中心还软软的，就可以了。从烤箱取出，在烤盘上静置5分钟定型（刚出炉时非常软，立刻移动会碎），然后移到晾网上彻底冷却。曲奇定型后边缘酥脆，中心软韧刚好。

d: 🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood
zh: 菲律宾牛尾蔬菜花生酱 | 菲律宾美食圣经第十集。Kare-kare是一道浓郁的菲律宾炖菜，用牛尾、牛肚和蔬菜在浓稠花生酱中慢炖而成。通常旁边配以虾酱来平衡风味，增添鲜味和咸度。食材：炖煮汤底：1-2个红洋葱切碎、2整头大蒜切碎、1汤匙盐、1汤匙胡椒粒、5-6片月桂叶、1公斤牛尾、650克牛肚、牛高汤（适量）。Kare Kare：10克胭脂树红粉、2汤匙油、15-20瓣大蒜切末、2汤匙胭脂树红粉、1个白洋葱切丁、1个香蕉花切碎（用盐洗净并冲洗）、牛高汤（适量）、四季豆切段、茄子切四瓣、小白菜/上海青、1杯半花生酱、鱼露（适量）、半茶匙盐、1汤匙糖（可选，按口味）。炒米浆：1:5比例的水和炒米，搅打均匀。配菜：虾酱、花生碎。步骤：先用盐和胡椒给肉调味并煎至焦黄。将所有“炖煮汤底”下的材料放入锅中，加入足量牛高汤。慢炖至软烂，取出肉，留汤备用。用油混合胭脂树红粉，炒香洋葱、大蒜和香蕉花。将肉放回锅中，加入之前留的炖汤，焖煮15-20分钟。为让汤汁浓稠，将炒米放入食物处理机或搅拌机打碎。取部分炒米粉与水混合制成米浆。将米浆和花生酱一起加入锅中搅拌，收汁至浓稠。用鱼露/盐/胡椒调味，加入蔬菜。搭配虾酱一同享用！

Kinilaw! Or what some people like to call “Filipino ceviche” but it’s so much more than that. Similar to ceviche, Kinilaw is a dish that uses acid to cure raw seafood, however, unlike ceviche Kinilaw uses native Filipino vinegars like coconut or cane boosted by calamansi. This style of preparation is native to the Philippines and dates back all the way to the 10-13th century AD and predates Spanish colonization. Each family has their own version, today I used frozen and thawed tuna, cucumber, red onion, and Thai chili peppers, however, I’ve also seen versions using shrimp, rare or cooked meats, and a variety of other  inclusions such as mango and coconut milk. It’s such a beautiful and refreshing lunch or dinner for these hot summer days and I hope you try to make it yourself because it’s a wonderful dish with a really cool history. I served mine with homemade crispy rice paper chips but tortillas is good too (or just with a big spoon and a bowl of rice! Original recipe by @Aileen Adalid  #filipino #filipinofood #seafood #tuna #ceviche

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

🇵🇭 Pork Binagoongan | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 11 One of the more underrated but S tier Filipino dishes!! Usually made with pork simmered in “bagoong alamang”, or fermented shrimp paste - best served with rice, sometimes with eggplant or green mango on the side. Its savory, funky, and slightly sweet, with tons of umami 💡Pro tip: adjust depending on your bagoong. Not all bagoong tastes the same — some are saltier, milder, or sweeter — so taste as you go and balance it out with sugar, vinegar, and tomatoes. INGREDIENTS: Binagoongan: - 1.5 kg pork ribs, blanched (you can use pork belly or cut of choice) - 5-6 tbsp bagoong guisado - 1 large onion, diced - 15-20 cloves garlic, sliced - 4 long green chilies, sliced - 350g tomatoes, sliced - 1/3 cup cane vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar - 1/4 cup soy sauce - Water as needed - Black pepper, to taste Bagoong Guisado: - 400g shrimp paste (alamang) - 25-30 cloves garlic - 7-10 red chilies - 6-7 shallots - 400g tomatoes, diced - 1/4 cup vinegar - 1/3 cup brown sugar Ensaladang Mangga: - Green mango - Red onion - Cilantro - Tomato - Lime - Salt - Pepper INSTRUCTIONS:  - Blanch pork for 10 minutes, before straining and rinsing. Set aside. - To make the bagoong start by blitzing onions or shallots, garlic, and red chilies in a processor.  Add to cold pan with oil and cook until garlic is slightly oasted add tomatoes, alamang, sugar and vinegar. 🇵🇭 Arroz a la Cubana | Filipino Food Bible Episode 5 Arroz a la Cubana originated in Spain, making its way to the Philippines during the colonial period. Though it is a popular humble dish in its country of origins, there are elements that are distinctly Filipino in our version that set it apart. Namely, the use of saba, ground meat and other seasonings! 😍 INGREDIENTS: Arroz a la Cubana: - 1 whole white onion, diced - 10-15 cloves of garlic, sliced - 1 large tomato, diced - 2-3 tsp of tomato paste - 2kg of ground beef - 1/3 cup of soy sauce - 2 tbsp of Worcestershire sauce - 1 large potato, diced - 1 large carrot, diced - 1-2 bell peppers, diced - 1/2 cup of green peas - 1/2 cup of raisins - 1 tbsp of Spanish paprika - Salt and pepper to taste Others: - saba banana, sliced in half and fried - 2 eggs, sunny side up INSTRUCTIONS:  - To start sauté onions, garlic, and tomatoes until soft before adding tomato paste and mixing them together.  - Then add your ground meat, adding Worcestershire and soy sauce. Add vegetables like carrots, potatoes, bell peppers, and green peas along with raisins for added sweetness.  - Mix together, and season with paprika, salt, and pepper.  - Serve with saba, a heaping serving of your arroz a la Cubana, fried eggs and enjoy! #cookingasmr #asmr #filipinofood #pinoyfood

d: Taco Loaded Potato Bowl 🌮🥔🔥 Doesn't get much better than this... easy, healthy and PACKED with flavor! Perfect quick simple delicious post workout meal, lunch or dinner! Great for meal prepping as well!  FULL RECIPE ⬇️ INGREDIENTS ~1.5 lbs Yukon gold potatoes  - 1 lb lean ground beef (Used 93/7)  - Extra virgin olive oil  - Taco Seasoning of choice  (I used @Grillin With Dad's)  Pico De Gallo (Combine all ingredients)  - 1 cup fresh diced tomatoes - 1/2 cup diced red onion  - 1 small jalapeño diced - (Remove seeds unless you want it spicy) - 1/2 cup chopped cilantro  - Juice of 1/2 a lime  - Salt to taste   Guacamole (Combine all ingredients)  - 2 medium sized avocados  - 1/2 cup diced red onion  - Juice of a lime  - 1/2 cup cilantro chopped  - Garlic powder to taste  - Salt to taste  Note: The measurements are estimated. Adjust ingredients to your liking.  Addition toppings: - Shredded Cheese - Sourcream - Cilantro  DIRECTIONS  1.  Prepare the Pico and guacamole then set in fridge.  2. Wash & dry the potatoes then dice them up into small cubes. Put them in a large bowl then add in olive oil and taco seasoning. Mix till well combined then place evenely on a lined baking sheet. Bake at 425 for ~30-35 minutes. Give a quick mix half way. 3. While the potatoes are in the oven, prep your ground beef. Add the ground beef to a greased large skillet over medium-high heat. Break it up then add in taco seasoning. Mix and add more if needed. I also like to add a bit of water or broth for extra moisture. Cook for 8-10 minutes mixing frequently until done to your liking.  4. Remove potatoes from oven and let cool for a few minutes.   5. Assemble your bowl & ENJOY! 🙌🏻 • • • • #explore #cooking #bhfyp #food #easyrecipe #simple #foodporn #healthy #tasty #healthyrecipes #calwillcookit #diet #healthylifestyle #mealprep #gains #weightloss #tacos #fitfood #highprotein

zh: 塔可土豆碗 🌮🥔🔥 没有比这更好的了……简单、健康且风味十足！完美快捷简单的美味健身餐、午餐或晚餐！也很适合备餐！完整食谱⬇️ 食材 ~1.5磅 育空黄金土豆 - 1磅 瘦牛肉末（用了93/7的） - 特级初榨橄榄油 - 任意塔可调味料（我用了@Grillin With Dad的） 皮科德加洛（混合所有食材） - 1杯 新鲜番茄丁 - 1/2杯 红洋葱丁 - 1个 小青辣椒丁 - （去籽，除非你想要辣） - 1/2杯 切碎的香菜 - 1/2个青柠的汁 - 盐适量 牛油果酱（混合所有食材） - 2个 中等大小牛油果 - 1/2杯 红洋葱丁 - 一个青柠的汁 - 1/2杯 切碎的香菜 - 大蒜粉适量 - 盐适量 注意：分量是估算值。请根据喜好调整食材。 额外配料： - 芝士碎 - 酸奶油 - 香菜 制作步骤 1. 准备皮科德加洛和牛油果酱，放入冰箱冷藏。 2. 土豆洗净擦干，切成小方块。放入大碗，加入橄榄油和塔可调味料。拌匀后均匀铺在铺好烘焙纸的烤盘上。425度烤约30-35分钟。中途快速翻拌一次。 3. 烤土豆时，准备牛肉末。将牛肉末放入已抹油的大煎锅，中高火加热。弄碎后加入塔可调味料。翻拌，需要时再加些。我也喜欢加一点点水或高汤增加水分。烹煮8-10分钟，期间频繁翻拌，直到熟至你喜欢的程度。 4. 从烤箱取出土豆，冷却几分钟。 5. 装碗开吃！🙌🏻 • • • •

d: Cowboy butter steak bites ✨ My husband ate both of these plates and rated it a 10/10 😭 Ingredients  Steak - 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, cubed - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount) “Caramelized” onions  - 1 large yellow onion, sliced - 1 tsp granulated sugar  - Heaping pinch of salt Cowboy butter - 12 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 garlic cloves, minced  - 1 shallot, minced  - 1 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference  - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste  Instructions  - Toss cubed steak with oil, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside while the pan heats. - Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. - Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside. - Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed). - Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium. - Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt. - Add steak back to the pan. - Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes. - Serve over creamy mashed potatoes and enjoy! • • • #recipe #steak #dinnerideas #food #steak

d: Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Chicken Alfredo Lasagna Rolls  Ingredients Chicken * 3–4 chicken breasts, cubed * ½ tsp salt * ½ tsp pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp oregano * 1 tbsp avocado oil * Shredded mozzarella * 6–8 lasagna sheets Spinach & Ricotta Filling * 1 yellow onion, chopped * 20 cloves garlic, minced * Olive oil * 1 lbs spinach * 1 cup ricotta * 1 egg * 1 cup grated Parmesan Alfredo Sauce * 4–5 cloves garlic, minced * 4 oz cream cheese * 2½ tbsp chicken broth * 1 cup heavy cream * ½ cup pasta water * 1 tsp oregano * ½ tsp paprika * ⅓ cup Parmesan Directions 1. Cook lasagna sheets until al dente and save the pasta water. 2. Season and cook cubed chicken in oil until fully cooked. Remove and set aside. 3. In the same pan, sauté onion and garlic. Add spinach and cook until wilted. Remove from heat and mix in ricotta, egg, and Parmesan. 4. Make the Alfredo in the same pan: sauté garlic, melt in cream cheese, then add broth, heavy cream, oregano, and paprika. Stir in Parmesan and pasta water until creamy. 5. Assemble: Spread a little Alfredo over each noodle, then add spinach mixture, chicken, and mozzarella. Roll up and place in a baking dish. 6. Pour remaining Alfredo over the rolls and top with mozzarella. 7. Cover and bake at 400°F for 15–20 minutes. Uncover and broil for a few minutes until golden and bubbly. #alfredo #chickenalfredo #lasagna #baked #creamy @Le Creuset

Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside. 5. In the same pot, add the diced jalapeño and red onion. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. 6. Stir in the sun-dried tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. 7. Add the Loisa Sofrito and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken stock and tomato sauce, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle boil. 9. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Serve over fluffy white rice and spoon plenty of the sauce over the top. #chickenlegs #braised #onepotmeals #cookwithme

Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. d: Recipe Name Loaded Pepperoni Pizza Pasta Bake Ingredients 1. 12 oz rotini or penne pasta 2. 1 lb ground beef 3. 4 oz pepperoni slices 4. 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 5. 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 6. 24 oz marinara sauce 7. 1 small onion, diced 8. 3 cloves garlic, minced 9. 1 tbsp olive oil 10. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 11. 1/2 tsp garlic powder 12. 1/2 tsp onion powder 13. 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes (optional) 14. Salt and black pepper to taste 15. 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté the onion until softened. 3. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. 4. Add ground beef and cook until browned, then drain excess grease. 5. Stir in marinara sauce, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. 6. Mix the cooked pasta into the meat sauce until evenly coated. 7. Transfer the mixture to a greased baking dish. 8. Sprinkle mozzarella and Parmesan cheese evenly over the top. 9. Arrange pepperoni slices across the casserole. 10. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20–25 minutes until bubbly and golden. 11. Broil for 2–3 minutes if you want extra browned cheese. 12. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot. Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta Bake INGREDIENTS  1 lb of Cellentani Pasta  1 lb cooked chicken (rotisserie chicken) 15 oz jar of Alfredo Sauce 1 Ranch seasoning packet  1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese 1 1/2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese 6 pieces of cooked and crumbled bacon Parsley INSTRUCTIONS  Cook at least 6 pieces of bacon and chop into small pieces. Boil one pound of pasta according to the directions on the package. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with cooking spray and set aside. Pour the cooked pasta into the bottom of the baking dish. Add about 1 lb of rotisserie chicken, one jar of Alfredo sauce, and a ranch seasoning packet. Add some of the mozzarella, cheddar cheese, and some of the bacon and stir everything together well.  Top with a little bit more cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, and crumbled bacon. Bake at 375 degrees F for about 15-20 minutes. Serve and enjoy! #easyrecipes #easydinners #chicken

d: Recipe Name Chicken, Ham and Swiss Stuffed Pull-Apart Bread Ingredients 1. 1 large loaf of soft French or Italian bread dough, about 1 1/2 pounds 2. 2 large cooked chicken breasts, thinly sliced 3. 8 ounces sliced ham 4. 8 ounces Swiss cheese slices 5. 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted 6. 3 cloves garlic, minced 7. 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, finely chopped 8. 1 teaspoon dried Italian seasoning 9. 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 10. 1/2 teaspoon salt 11. 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 12. 1 large egg, beaten 13. 2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. 3. Roll the bread dough into a large rectangle approximately 12 by 18 inches. 4. Arrange the sliced chicken evenly down the center of the dough. 5. Layer the ham over the chicken, keeping the filling centered. 6. Place the Swiss cheese slices over the ham to create an even layer of melted cheese. 7. Fold the dough around the filling, pinching the seams firmly underneath. 8. Place the stuffed loaf seam-side down on the prepared baking sheet. 9. Using a sharp knife, make several deep diagonal cuts across the top, spacing them about 1 inch apart without cutting completely through the loaf. 10. Gently separate the cuts slightly so the filling is visible between the sections. 11. Combine the melted butter, garlic, parsley, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. 12. Brush the seasoned butter generously over the entire loaf. 13. Brush the exposed dough with beaten egg for a glossy golden crust. 14. Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese over the top. 15. Bake for 25–35 minutes, until the bread is deeply golden and the cheese is completely melted. 16. If the top browns too quickly, loosely cover it with foil for the final few minutes. 17. Remove from the oven and let the loaf rest for 8–10 minutes. 18. Brush with a little more garlic butter and garnish with fresh parsley. 19. Pull apart or slice into portions and serve while hot and cheesy. Follow this account for more irresistible stuffed recipes and easy comfort-food ideas you will want to make again.

Recipe Name French Onion Meatloaf with Melted Mozzarella Ingredients 1. 2 lbs (900 g) ground beef 2. 1 cup breadcrumbs 3. 2 large eggs 4. 1 small onion, finely diced 5. 2 large onions, thinly sliced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 1/3 cup milk 8. 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 2 tbsp ketchup 10. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 11. 1 tsp salt 12. 1 tsp black pepper 13. 1 tsp garlic powder 14. 1 tsp dried thyme 15. 2 tbsp butter 16. 1 tbsp olive oil 17. 1 cup beef broth 18. 1 tbsp all-purpose flour 19. 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 20. 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a loaf pan or baking dish. 2. Heat the butter and olive oil in a skillet. Add the sliced onions and cook over medium-low heat for 20–25 minutes until deeply caramelized. 3. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle in the flour, then add the beef broth and simmer until slightly thickened. Remove from the heat. 4. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, diced onion, milk, Worcestershire sauce, ketchup, Dijon mustard, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and thyme. 5. Mix gently until just combined, then shape into a loaf and place in the prepared pan. 6. Bake for 40 minutes. 7. Remove the meatloaf from the oven and spoon the caramelized onion mixture evenly over the top. 8. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese generously over the onions. 9. Return the meatloaf to the oven and bake for another 15–20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and lightly golden. 10. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 11. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley for extra flavor and color. 12. Serve hot with creamy mashed potatoes and your favorite vegetables. Follow for more delicious and easy recipes!

d: BUN BO HUE aka my favorite food EVER 🥢 #bunbohue #vietnamesefood #noodles #easyrecipe #asmr  Bun Bo Hue Broth - Flank steak - Parboiled beef bones - Lemongrass - Pineapple - Ginger - Daikon - Shallot - Yellow onion - Water - Salt - Chicken bouillon - Mushroom bouillon - Fish sauce - Shrimp paste - Saté Parboil the flank steak and beef bones for 5–10 minutes, then rinse well. Add to a large stock pot with slightly smashed lemongrass, pineapple, ginger, daikon, shallot, onion, and a few spoonfuls of salt. Cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 1 hour, continuously skimming the scum from the top. Remove the flank steak and set aside to cool, then add the saté and simmer the broth for another 5 hours. Remove the onion, shallot, and ginger (I keep the daikon for my bowls) and season with chicken bouillon, mushroom bouillon, fish sauce, and shrimp paste. Taste and adjust to your preference. Saté - Shallot - Garlic - Lemongrass - Avocado oil - BBH seasoning - Red pepper flakes - Sugar - Shrimp paste - Fish sauce Sauté finely minced shallot, garlic, and lemongrass in avocado oil for about 5 minutes, until slightly golden and fragrant. Add a packet of BBH seasoning and red pepper flakes and sauté for another 2 minutes. Add half to the broth and reserve the other half for garnish. To the reserved saté, add a small ladle of broth, sugar, shrimp paste, and fish sauce, then sauté for another couple minutes. Bowl - Thick rice vermicelli - Cabbage - Bean sprouts - Sliced flank steak - Yellow onion - Green onion - Cilantro - Lime - Saté I like to prep all my toppings ahead of time and store them in glass containers for easy assembly throughout the week. Rinse and dry the cabbage and bean sprouts well, then store in a paper towel-lined container. Keep the sliced flank steak separate. For the noodles, boil for 10–15 minutes depending on thickness, then turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for another 10–15 minutes. Strain and rinse very well to remove excess starch, then let dry for about 15 minutes before assembling.

d: A woman who was hiking with her dog escaped a scary encounter with a grizzly bear in Alberta, Canada. Video shows her yelling and making loud sounds as the bear charged at them. According to the Canadian adventure business that posted the footage, the woman was walking in a known grizzly habitat with no bear spray - and was only carrying a bear bell, which they advised against. They said bears are "curious about dogs" and shared the video to stress the importance of carrying bear spray. "This could have been prevented," the group said. "She was unprepared and/or poorly informed — and should have known better." #grizzlybear #canada #alberta

d: Crispy Beef Tacos 🌮 I think the Mexicans are onto something here because this stuff is gooood!! I guess you can’t go wrong with crispy tacos, beef and loads of cheese 🧀 Ingredients: Beef filling 500g beef mince White tortillas 1 large onion, diced 6–7 garlic cloves, minced 2 tbsp tomato paste 1 tbsp chilli powder 1½ tsp ground cumin 1 tsp salt 1 tsp black pepper ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder ½ tsp dried oregano Avocado Sauce 🥑 2 large avocados 3 green chillies 2 handfuls fresh coriander ½ large onion 2–3 garlic cloves Salt, to taste MSG, to taste Water, to thin Toppings Chopped onion Chopped tomato Red Leicester Mature Cheddar Mozzarella Method 1️⃣ Heat a pan with a little oil and add the beef mince. Sear the beef over a high heat and let it develop some good colour. The more you brown the beef, the better the flavour. 2️⃣ Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1–2 minutes, then add the tomato paste and cook it out. 3️⃣ Add the diced onion and sauté for another 2–3 minutes. Add all the taco seasonings and cook for a further 2–3 minutes. If it starts catching on the bottom of the pan, add a splash of water. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4️⃣ For the avocado sauce, add the avocados, green chillies, coriander, onion, garlic, salt and MSG to a blender. Blend until smooth, adding a little water until you get your desired consistency. 5️⃣ Add your cheese of choice to one half of each tortilla, followed by the beef mixture. Add another layer of cheese over the beef and fold the tortilla closed. 6️⃣ Heat a little oil in a pan and, once hot, add the tacos. Cook for 2–3 minutes on each side until golden and crispy. Try not to move them around too much while cooking or the filling may fall out. 7️⃣ Once crispy on both sides, carefully open the tacos and finish with the avocado sauce, chopped onions and tomatoes. #fyp #easyrecipes #tacos #mexicanfood
zh: 脆皮牛肉塔可 🌮 我觉得墨西哥人在这方面真有点东西，因为这玩意儿太好吃了！！我想，脆脆的塔可、牛肉和大量芝士绝对不会错 🧀 食材： 牛肉馅料 500克牛肉糜 白玉米饼 1个大洋葱，切丁 6-7瓣大蒜，切末 2汤匙番茄膏 1汤匙辣椒粉 1½茶匙孜然粉 1茶匙盐 1茶匙黑胡椒 ½茶匙红椒粉 ½茶匙大蒜粉 ½茶匙洋葱粉 ½茶匙干牛至 牛油果酱 🥑 2个大牛油果 3个青辣椒 2把新鲜香菜 ½个大洋葱 2-3瓣大蒜 盐，适量 味精，适量 水，用于稀释 顶料 洋葱碎 番茄碎 红莱斯特芝士 成熟切达芝士 马苏里拉芝士 步骤 1️⃣ 锅中加少许油，放入牛肉糜。大火煎牛肉，让它上色。牛肉煎得越焦香，风味越佳。 2️⃣ 加入蒜末，翻炒1-2分钟，然后加入番茄膏炒熟。 3️⃣ 加入洋葱丁，再翻炒2-3分钟。加入所有塔可调味料，再煮2-3分钟。如果锅底开始粘锅，就加少量水。离火，备用。 4️⃣ 制作牛油果酱：将牛油果、青辣椒、香菜、洋葱、大蒜、盐和味精放入搅拌机。搅打至顺滑，加少量水直到达到你想要的稠度。 5️⃣ 在每张玉米饼的一半放上你选择的芝士，再放上牛肉馅料。在牛肉上再盖一层芝士，然后把玉米饼对折合上。 6️⃣ 平底锅加少许油，油热后放入塔可。每面煎2-3分钟，直到金黄酥脆。煎的时候尽量少翻动，否则馅料可能会掉出来。 7️⃣ 两面煎脆后，小心打开塔可，最后加入牛油果酱、洋葱碎和番茄碎。

d: Charcoal Char Kway Teow. From the streets of Malaysia not Indonesia, not Thailand and definitely not Singapore, with Penang probably being the place most famous for it. Back in the day it was cheap, fast food for workers. Thick rice noodles thrown into a ripping hot wok with soy, egg, bean sprouts, chilli and seafood. Traditionally a lot of it was cooked over charcoal, which gives you that extra smoky flavour and proper wok hei. #CharKwayTeow #PenangFood #MalaysianFood #WokHei #StreetFood
zh: 炭火炒粿条。源自马来西亚街头，而非印尼、泰国，更不是新加坡，槟城或许是最负盛名之地。早年是工人的廉价快餐。厚米粉在滚烫铁锅中，加入酱油、鸡蛋、豆芽、辣椒和海鲜快炒。传统上多用炭火烹制，带来独特的烟熏风味和十足锅气。

d: 30 years of perfecting what might be the BEST fried chicken I have eaten in Bangkok! 🍗 Tucked away in Bangkok's Chinatown, J Poon Fried Chicken has been frying fresh chicken to order for over 30 years. Every piece comes out incredibly crispy on the outside, while staying juicy and tender on the inside. Simple, but done exceptionally well. If you're exploring Chinatown, this is definitely a spot worth adding to your list. 📍 J Poon Fried Chicken 856 Maha Chai Rd, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200 🕘 Open Tuesday–Sunday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ❌ Closed Mondays #thailand #bangkok #thaifood #streetfood #friedchicken
zh: 30年匠心，成就曼谷最美味的炸鸡！藏在曼谷唐人街的J Poon炸鸡，30多年来坚持现点现炸。每一块都外皮极其酥脆，内里鲜嫩多汁。做法简单，但功夫到家。如果你在逛唐人街，这家店绝对值得加入清单。地址：J Poon Fried Chicken 856 Maha Chai Rd, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200 营业时间：周二至周日 9:00 – 17:00 周一休息
